name: Background agent environment runs a committed command
description: A command .cursor/environment.json hands a background agent: install runs as the environment is created, start runs as the agent boots, and a terminals entry runs after start in the session the agent shares. No user action gates any of them, so committing the file is enough to have the command run. A terminals entry carries the name that tells it from its siblings. Environment configuration applies to Cursor-hosted Cloud Agents, so the command runs on a Cursor-hosted machine rather than the developer's.
message: Background agent environment runs this command with no user action

name: Background agent image is built from a committed Dockerfile
description: A build key names the Dockerfile the background agent's image is built from: dockerfile carries the path of one, dockerfileContents the file itself. Either way the instructions are committed configuration, and building the image is what runs them. The phase says which key declared the value, and the value is stored exactly as the config spells it. Environment configuration applies to Cursor-hosted Cloud Agents, so the image is built on a Cursor-hosted machine rather than the developer's.
message: Background agent image is built from a Dockerfile this repository declares
